title: Intravitreal Ranibizumab Injections Significantly Influence Retinal Venous Calibre in Patients With Diabetic Macular Oedema

groups.agent: ranibizumab, three monthly loading injections then PRN to month 12 (RESTORE protocol)
groups.description: Treatment-naive eyes with centre-involving DMO recruited in a prospective cytokine study; this post hoc analysis set holds the 35 'Study' eyes with retinal photographs available at baseline, month 2 and month 12

exclusions.what: BCVA at baseline and change at months 2 and 12 (Table 2, tbl-0002!R6C2, R6C3, R6C5)
exclusions.reason: Complete-case analysis set (protocol inclusion 5): the analysis includes only eyes with complete data (Results: 35 of the 76 treated eyes, with retinal photographs available at baseline, month 2 and month 12; Methods: primary analysis set of subjects with complete data at baseline and month 2), a stated analysis set of the eyes seen at the follow-up visits out of a larger treated cohort; the number of eyes behind the BCVA row is not stated.

exclusions.what: Baseline BCVA of included and excluded eyes (Table 1, tbl-0001!R9)

exclusions.reason: Untreated fellow eyes are out of scope (protocol inclusion 5); no acuity is tabulated for them.

notes: Acuity unit: ETDRS letters (Table 1 row label 'Baseline BCVA (letters)', Methods and Results text); the Table 2 footnote states mean and SD and change = month score minus baseline score.
Table 1 marks the included eyes as having complete baseline and month 2 data, while the Results define them by photographs at baseline, month 2 and month 12; either definition is a complete-data set.
Regimen three monthly loading injections then PRN; prior treatment naive (Abstract).
Retinal vascular calibre, central macular thickness and blood pressure are not extracted.
